Role: AI Product Manager, Superhumans & Console
Location: Remote, US
Level: Senior

Requirements:
- 5+ years product management (2+ on AI-native product where UX was the product)
- Owned a surface users loved (founder or early-startup experience ideal)
- Built or owned a builder, editor, or configuration product
- Funnel thinking (signup to activation to habit) with time-to-value and retention results
- Technical enough for prompt, context, and config changes; reads conversation traces
- Prototypes with code or design tools before writing docs
- Clear writing

Preferred:
- Voice, video, or real-time conversational products
- Product-led growth and self-serve funnels with pricing or packaging
- GTM depth (quota or CS book experience)
- Analytics or dashboard products
- Enterprise admin (roles, permissions, workspace management)

Responsibilities:
- Latency and interruption handling, in-call assists, interactive demos
- Console features (persona, goals, ICP, knowledge, guardrails, preview, publish)
- Self-serve onboarding and analytics
- Personalization and shared context graph
